scoring_justification: Cannot re-run Monte Carlo simulation in the checker; compare extracted slope of δh² vs ln(L) to paper-reported slope with tolerance.

hidden_assets.purpose: Paper-reported slope of linear fit δh² vs ln L at t=0.5 for model A, derived from Fig. 1 inset text: δh² = 0.00889233 + 0.0406318 ln L.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'best linear fit, δh²=0.00889233+0.0406318 ln L'
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly quoted numerical result from the article.

schema.notes: L is integer system size; delta_h2 is float mean-square height fluctuation.

outputs.description: CSV file containing mean-square height fluctuation delta_h2 for system sizes L=24,48,72 at temperature t=0.5.

output_contract.notes: The checker computes ln(L) and performs ordinary linear regression to extract the slope, then compares it to the hidden paper-reported value using a relative tolerance. The delta_h2 values must increase monotonically with L.

steps.description: Verify δh² increases monotonically with L (trend check).
Perform linear regression of δh² on ln(L) and compare slope to paper-reported value with tolerance.
